# orion note

Add a note, optionally between two linked items

```sh
orion note [options] [text...]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `[text...]` | Note text |
| `--group <value>` | Group to add it to |
| `--after <value>` | Item the note follows |
| `--before <value>` | Item the note leads into |
| `--json` | Print JSON |
